title: PMK 168/2023: bases and employment-class routing
summary: Encode the daily-above-2.5m route, resident individual service/event/pension-withdrawal/former-employee bases, irregular commissioners and permanent-employee/pensioner final-period reconciliation. The Article 17 layers are preserved but their calculation bases and TER routing differ by recipient class.
